policies.title: Solar ALMM List-II: approved Indian solar cells required
policies.what: Government-backed, net-metered and open-access solar projects commissioned from 1 June 2026 must use modules made with cells from approved Indian makers.
policies.source_name: TaiyangNews — ALMM List-II comes into force
policies.reaction: Waaree Energies, Premier Energies and Emmvee rose about 4% on 26 May after MNRE refused to extend the deadline.

policies.title: DGTR anti-dumping probe on aluminium extrusions
policies.what: Investigation into extrusions from China, Malaysia, Vietnam and Thailand, which make up about 90% of these imports. No duty yet: DGTR must recommend one and the Finance Ministry must impose it.
policies.next_step: DGTR final findings, then a Finance Ministry decision
policies.source_name: AlCircle — DGTR aluminium probe

policies.title: DGTR recommends 5-year extension of duty on aluminium foil imports
policies.what: Recommended $93.53–976.99 per tonne on foil of 80 micron and below from China, Thailand, Malaysia and Indonesia. The existing duty runs until 15 Dec 2026.
policies.next_step: Finance Ministry notification before the current duty lapses
policies.source_name: The Pioneer — DGTR backs 5-year duty on aluminium foil

policies.title: STQC certification mandatory for internet-connected CCTV
policies.what: CCTV products need STQC approval before sale. Chinese brands such as Hikvision, Dahua and TP-Link, and devices with Chinese-origin chipsets, are reportedly being refused.
policies.source_name: Communications Today — Chinese CCTV firms barred

policies.title: ₹10,000 cr Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme
policies.what: Support up to FY40 for new or expanded shipping-container factories, to cut India's dependence on imported containers.
policies.authority: Union Cabinet / Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways
policies.source_name: Upstox — container scheme puts Kalyani Cast-Tech, Jupiter Wagons in focus

policies.title: 24–52% duty on Chinese cranes, recommended but still not imposed
policies.what: DGTR recommended duties on Chinese crawler and truck cranes in September 2025; about a year later the Finance Ministry still had not notified them. A case study in how long a recommendation can sit.
policies.source_name: Outlook Business — crane duty still awaiting government nod

policies.title: ₹2,814 cr capex support for lithium and nickel processing
policies.what: A 30% capital subsidy for two lithium and two nickel refining plants, capped at ₹500 cr and ₹900 cr per plant. Winners are picked by who asks for the least support.
policies.source_name: Upstox — metal stocks in focus on critical mineral scheme

policies.title: DAC clears ₹1.10 lakh cr of defence purchases, 98% from Indian industry
policies.what: The Defence Acquisition Council gave in-principle approval (AoN) to about ₹1.10 lakh cr of procurement, almost all to be sourced domestically. Orders come later.
policies.source_name: Upstox — defence stocks rally on ₹1.10 lakh cr procurement
policies.reaction: Nifty India Defence index closed 2.5% higher on 8 Sep, with MIDHANI leading gainers.

policies.title: Sixth Positive Indigenisation List: 405 defence items
policies.what: 405 more items reserved for Indian suppliers, with an estimated ₹3,070 cr of business potential.
policies.source_name: Kotak Neo — sixth indigenisation list
policies.reaction: Defence stocks rose up to 10%; Paras Defence gained 10% and Zen Technologies over 7%.

policies.title: DGTR anti-dumping probes on 7 Chinese products, incl. Penicillin G and Amoxycillin
policies.what: Investigations into Chinese imports including key drug ingredients Penicillin G, Amoxycillin Trihydrate and Montelukast, plus rubber and elevator parts. No duty yet.
policies.next_step: DGTR final findings, then a Finance Ministry decision
policies.source_name: NewKerala (IANS) — India opens probes into seven Chinese products

policies.title: ₹14,500 cr viability gap funding for 92 GWh grid-scale energy storage
policies.what: Support over FY27–FY31 for 30 GWh of battery storage, 60 GWh of pumped hydro and 2 GWh of new technologies, awarded by tariff bidding. Battery projects must meet 40% domestic content.
policies.stocks: Exide Industries, Amara Raja Energy & Mobility
policies.source_name: Angel One — Cabinet approves grid storage scheme

policies.title: EU 9.5% anti-dumping duty on Indian cold-rolled steel
policies.what: A definitive EU duty on certain uncoated cold-rolled flat steel from India, which makes Indian exports to Europe costlier.
policies.source_name: Ventura Securities — EU duty on Indian steel

policies.title: EVs made the default choice for government staff cars
policies.what: Revised purchase rules make electric vehicles the default for central government staff cars and double the allowed price ceiling. It covers government fleets only, not private buyers.
policies.source_name: Kotak Neo — EVs default for government cars
policies.reaction: Auto and EV shares mostly rose on 11 Nov, led by M&M; JBM Auto was the only tracked stock to close lower.

policies.title: Import registration for laptops and tablets
policies.what: DGFT moved laptop and tablet imports to a registration system from 1 Nov. Officials say it will be simple and non-restrictive at first, so watch for tightening.
policies.source_name: India Sea Trade News — DGFT import registration for laptops

policies.title: ₹62,500 cr Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme (MPMS)
policies.what: Production-linked incentives of roughly 2.25–5% on eligible phone sales for FY27–FY31, replacing the mobile PLI that ended in March 2026.
policies.stocks: Dixon Technologies, Kaynes Technology, Syrma SGS, Amber Enterprises
policies.source_name: Upstox — Dixon, Kaynes, Syrma in spotlight
policies.reaction: EMS stocks rallied up to 7% on 16 Jul (Dixon, Kaynes, Cyient DLM); Dixon traded over 4% higher.

policies.title: ₹1.86 lakh cr PM-DHARA (Green Energy Corridor III)
policies.what: ₹1,36,378 cr for state transmission lines plus ₹50,000 cr for 50 GWh of battery storage, to move up to 135 GW of renewable power by FY33.
policies.stocks: Power Grid, Adani Energy Solutions, GE Vernova T&D India, Hitachi Energy India, CG Power, Transformers & Rectifiers
policies.source_name: Upstox — what PM-DHARA means for stocks
policies.reaction: Equipment makers rose on 1 Oct (Transformers & Rectifiers up to 10%, Adani Energy Solutions about 5%), but Power Grid, Tata Power and NTPC fell 1–2% in a weak market — a 'sell the news' day for utilities.

policies.title: BIS Quality Control Order on 90 electrical appliances
policies.what: ISI certification is now mandatory for about 90 household and commercial appliances, which filters out uncertified cheap imports. Small enterprises have until 1 January 2027.
policies.also_watch: Havells, Crompton Greaves Consumer, Bajaj Electricals, TTK Prestige
policies.source_name: Corpseed — Electrical appliances QCO 2026

policies.title: DGTR recommends 5 more years of $268/t duty on Chinese seamless pipes
policies.what: A sunset review found dumping would likely continue, so DGTR recommended keeping the duty. The current duty was extended only until 27 Jan 2027, so the Finance Ministry has to notify before then or the duty lapses.
policies.stocks: Jindal Saw, Maharashtra Seamless, Kirloskar Ferrous
policies.source_name: SteelOrbis — DGTR recommends 5-year AD duty on Chinese seamless pipes

policies.title: Draft National Steel Policy: Vision 2047
policies.what: A Ministry of Steel draft roadmap targeting 604 million tonnes of crude steel capacity by 2047. Still a draft, so nothing is binding yet.
policies.next_step: Final National Steel Policy after consultations
policies.source_name: Outlook Money — draft steel policy lifts steel stocks
policies.reaction: Steel stocks traded higher in early trade on 12 Oct; SAIL gained over 3%.

policies.title: Anti-dumping duty on Chinese titanium dioxide restored for 5 years
policies.what: $460–681 per tonne on titanium dioxide from China, ending a 13-month gap with no duty. It protects domestic TiO2 makers but raises a key raw-material cost for paint companies.
policies.also_watch: Asian Paints, Berger Paints, Kansai Nerolac
policies.source_name: TaxGuru — Notification 26/2026-Customs (ADD)
